content:
Extract physical items and containers. Return one ItemCandidates JSON object only: {items:[...], containers:[...]}. Item fields: name, description, unique, quantity, quality, holder_hint, location_hint. Container fields: name, description, state, owner_hint, holder_hint, location_hint, position, unlocking_item_names. state is exactly hidden|locked|unlocked|open.

Rules for local models:
1. A container is an entity intended to hold items or equipment and whose open/locked/hidden state matters, such as a chest, locked cabinet, bag, box, or safe. Put it only in containers, not also in items.
2. unlocking_item_names contains exact names of extracted items explicitly said to unlock it. Otherwise empty.
3. Ownership, holding, and location are independent: copy exact character/place names only when stated. Do not guess. position is a short within-location placement or null.
4. Items are portable physical objects. Do not extract abstractions, body parts, landmarks, or currency amounts. Unknown placement is allowed.
5. Every fact must be supported by the source. Empty lists are correct.

Canonical example (fully invented placeholder content - never copy this example's names or wording; draw every field from your own supplied content):
{"items":[{"name":"a woven basket","description":"A large woven basket used for carrying fresh bread.","unique":false,"quantity":3,"quality":"good","holder_hint":"Example Character","location_hint":null}],"containers":[{"name":"a wooden crate","description":"A wooden crate used to store spare cloth and twine under the stall.","state":"open","owner_hint":"Example Character","holder_hint":null,"location_hint":"Example Location","position":"under the stall","unlocking_item_names":[]}]}
